name: Kaise Tech
format: One curiosity question ('X kaise kaam karta hai?'), one visual metaphor, 30-60 s, speech from frame 0

voice.style: curious, warm, energetic young Indian tech explainer talking to a friend; surprise at the reveal, playful at the end
voice.style_en: curious, warm, energetic young Indian tech explainer talking to a friend; surprise at the reveal, playful at the end

visuals.look: glossy 3D Pixar-style, dark navy studio, soft blue rim light, yellow accent #ffd84d
visuals.cast: topic objects as characters (no fixed mascot)

edit.captions: 3-word chunks, spoken word lit, keywords yellow

rules: news: verify with 2+ trusted sources before making anything; never invent or assume an event
topics_backlog: UPI paisa 2 second mein kaise pahunchta hai
WiFi deewar ke paar kaise jaata hai
Fingerprint unlock kaise kaam karta hai
Fast charging phone ko kharab karti hai kya
GPS ko kaise pata ki aap kahan ho
pillars: Kaise kaam karta hai: everyday tech explained with one visual idea (UPI, WiFi, GPS, battery)
AI kaise: how AI tools work and how to use them (ChatGPT, Gemini, image/video AI) with real screen captures
AI ka naya: new AI launches explained in 30-45 s, why it matters for you (sourced)
Tech raaz: myths and hidden features (fast charging, airplane mode, incognito)
Free tool of the day: one free AI/GitHub tool that replaces a paid one (real demo)

Tech news, samjho: big tech/AI news (CEO changes, launches, bans, AI rules) explained in 30-45 s; only verified facts from 2+ trusted sources named on screen; real official visuals, no AI fakes of real people; neutral tone, no speculation; no politics/general news

warmup.note: new accounts: profile + manual engagement 17-19 Nov, 1 reel/day (20:00) 20-26 Nov, then 2/day
